target.title: fix(agents): handle stderr stream errors in tool_search_code child
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`tool_search_code` spawns a Node child and reads stderr. If the stderr stream emits an error event, it is not handled and can become an unhandled exception.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add an explicit `child.stderr?.on("error", ...)` listener that rejects the run promise, mirroring the existing `child.on("error")` handling.

## User Impact

Tool Search code-mode runs are more resilient to transient stream failures.

## Evidence

- Added regression test in `src/agents/tool-search.stream-errors.test.ts`.
- Exposed `runCodeModeChild` and `ToolSearchRuntime` on the `testing` barrel for focused testing.
- Added real behavior proof at `scripts/proof/tool-search-code-mode-stream-errors.mts`.
- Local run:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tool-search.stream-errors.test.ts` passed
